html: We create connections with the power of reciprocity.

♥︎ Skill sharing and education
♦︎ Temporary trading and renting
♣︎ Bartering and purchasing

Lasting friendships are formed from simple beginnings like asking a neighbor for a spoonful of salt.
What you give in this world, you get back. We help make sure of that =)

Not only are we a cryptocurrency, but we are also the future of all e-commerce. Anything someone could offer for rent or sale will be available through our app, and any skill or work that someone can provide is also here. Additionally, we are a place that connects those who teach and those who desire knowledge. We do this through masterminds and workshops, both digitally and in person.
Here are some examples of the types of skilled people who will offer their services or teach their skills with Energy for Energy:

House and auto repair and upkeep:
Mechanics, upholstery workers, electricians, painters, vinyl wrappers, plumbers, tile workers, landscapers, bush sculpture artists, pest control, and carpenters.

Health and wellness:
Doctors, dentists, optometrists, psychologists, life coaches, sports ball coaches, physical trainers, massage therapists, cuddlers, personal chefs, dermatologists, and other specialists.

Helpers and time-saving personnel:
Delivery drivers, babysitters, nannies, dog walkers, pet sitters, house sitters, caterers, videographers,

Remote help:
Video editors, photo editors, graphic designers, marketers, writers, coders, software engineers, web designers, user interface/experience designers, app developers, game designers, joke writers, virtual assistants, VR, AR, and mixed reality developers.

Magicians, jugglers, comedians, face painters, flow artists, balloon artists, clowns, poets, acrobats, mimes, bartenders, hibachi grill performers, body airbrush artists, DJs, MCs, actors, singers, musicians, voice-over actors, artists, sculptors, woodworkers, 3D printing experts of all mediums, glass blowers, human statues, caricature artists, stilt walkers, unicyclists, sideshow freaks, silk dancers, Cirque performers, spray paint artists, psychics, BMX drivers, dancers, street theater performers, ventriloquists, escape artists, contortionists, Yo-yo tricksters, Cosplay costume designers, pirates, hypnotists, pottery molding instructors, food sculptures, ice sculptures, skaters, Drone racers, RC car racers, rappers, beatboxers, and a Cappella groups.
